description: This file defines the ObjectFormatter class responsible for formatting and translating objects for UI display in the Winscope tool, including handling proto objects, flicker objects, and intdef mappings.

classes.name: ObjectFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting objects, translating proto objects, handling intdef mappings, and preparing data for UI display in the Winscope tool.

methods.name: cloneObject
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of an object with only its true properties.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves the true properties of an object, filtering out functions, internal, private, and flicker-related properties.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats an object into a PropertiesDump suitable for UI display, handling nested objects and proto translations.

methods.name: translateObject
methods.description: Translates proto objects into their flicker or UI-friendly equivalents based on type.

methods.name: formatColorTransform
methods.description: Formats color transform arrays into a readable string.

methods.name: getTypeDefSpec
methods.description: Retrieves typedef metadata from proto object fields.

methods.name: translateIntDef
methods.description: Converts integer properties into string representations based on intdef mappings.

methods.name: getIntFlagsAsStrings
methods.description: Converts integer flag values into human-readable string flags based on mapping.
